content.text: {"problem": {"theorem": "证明两个能被 3 整除的整数之和仍能被 3 整除。", "assumptions": ["a,b 为整数，且 3|a、3|b。"], "domain": "elementary_algebra", "explicit_subgoals": []}, "target": {"node_id": "n3", "version": 1}, "target_node": {"text": "因为 m+n 是整数，所以 3|a+b。", "claim": "由 m+n 为整数以及 a+b=3(m+n)，得到 3|a+b。", "scope": [], "depends_on": ["n1", "n2"], "goal_refs": ["main"]}, "closed_predecessors": [{"node_id": "n1", "version": 1, "claim": "由 3|a、3|b，引入整数 m,n，使得 a=3m 且 b=3n。", "text": "存在整数 m,n，使 a=3m，b=3n。", "scope": [], "depends_on": []}, {"node_id": "n2", "version": 1, "claim": "将 a=3m、b=3n 代入并提取公因数 3，得到 a+b=3(m+n)。", "text": "于是 a+b=3m+3n=3(m+n)。", "scope": [], "depends_on": ["n1"]}], "counterexample_search": true, "rule_candidates": []}
